verdict.rationale: Letta documents scheduled tasks that automate prompts to an agent on a recurring schedule or at a specific future time (letta-docs-69). It positions schedules plus cloud computers as always-on coworkers that keep running while your laptop is closed (letta-docs-68, letta-docs-55), and headless mode lets external schedulers and CI/CD pipelines drive agents (letta-docs-4). Missing for 10: schedule configuration details (cron syntax, time zones, listing/editing/pausing jobs), multi-step workflow orchestration beyond prompting an agent, run history/failure handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
